name: gap_fade_reversion_v103
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps up or down >0.3% overnight, option market makers who sold gamma are immediately delta-offside and begin hedging within the first 30 seconds — selling into gap-ups and buying into gap-downs. Simultaneously, VWAP/TWAP algorithms with previous-close benchmarks aggressively fade the opening price, creating a 20-50 spot point reversion impulse in the first 60-90 seconds of the session. At 5-second resolution, we detect the moment this institutional fade starts (price reversing back toward prev close within the first 5 bars of the day) and enter before the bulk of the impulse occurs, targeting the first leg of gap closure.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap > 0.3% day: price crosses back toward prev close with 15s positive momentum and above-average volume within first 20 minutes
